evidence: The dynamic fee system contains a cconflicting fee caps between `DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee()` and `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` which renders the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective. The `DynamicSwapFeeModule` allows fees up to 500,000 (50%) internally, but `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` rejects any fee above 100,000 (10%), causing the system to always fall back to basic tick spacing fees.

As a result, any dynamically calculated fee above 10% gets rejected reducing potential protocol revenue.
